result.summary: Independently re-verified all 11 REQ-200 acceptance criteria against the real lib/letflow/instances.ex and lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex code (not the design doc or prior gate reports): the 4-level actor fallback chain (resolve_actor_display_name/3, instances.ex L234-248) is total and genuinely distinct at each level including the deleted-user case (fetch_display_names_by_actor_id/2 only maps ids that resolved to a non-blank display_name, so a deleted user's id is structurally indistinguishable from 'never looked up' and falls through the same has_key? check -- AC2/AC3 hold for real, not just because the test happens to pass); render_description/3 has one clause per real event type plus a mandatory catch-all fallback clause (AC4/AC5); timeline_item_map/1 (routers/instances.ex L654-667) emits exactly web/src/types/api.ts's TimelineEntry field set including the timestamp/sequence_num renames (AC6); the batched actor lookup issues exactly one `users` query keyed by distinct non-nil actor_ids per page, done outside the per-event map (AC7); AC8's five REQ-080 assertions (route, :InstancesRead gating, ascending order, cursor pagination, cross-tenant 404) are still covered by their original passing tests, confirmed re-run. Re-ran `git diff main...HEAD --stat` myself: confirms lib/letflow/api/authorization.ex is untouched (AC10), no file under web/ is touched (AC9), and test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs is untouched (supports the rustc-flake attribution). Independently re-ran the full suite via scripts/test_parallel.sh myself (not trusting TEST-RUNNER's report): reproduced 2749/2751 passed, 2 failures, both the identical Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest :enoent failures at the same lines, confirmed `which rustc` returns nothing in this sandbox -- genuine environment flake, not a regression. Ran test/letflow/routers/instances_test.exs standalone myself: 44/44 passed. Ran `mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force` myself: clean, 0 warnings (AC11). Full independent basis: handoffs/WF02-REQ200-20260830/req200-release-validation-report.md.
